title: Leads backend core: create, list, get, edit, references, duplicate check, bulk reassign
objective: Leads can be created per the FR-29/FR-30 intake contract (with system ref generation, inline party creation, duplicate warning, priority derivation), listed with full filtering and breadth-permission enforcement, edited (facts only), and bulk-reassigned (spec FR-29..FR-32, FR-43 backend, §9.3).
scope: Tables: leads, lead_assignments, lead_notes, reference_sequences (all partitioned except reference_sequences keyed by tenant)
CreateLead, UpdateLead, GetLead, ListLeads, BulkReassign handlers + endpoints
Party list lead-counts columns + GET /api/v1/parties/{id}/leads (completes T-017 list)
implementation_details: Liquibase 090-leads: leads with all spec §11.3 columns (status_id FK reference_items lead status; policy_term text check + policy_term_other text null per Q-11; source text check in ('browser','api'); intake_credential_id bigint null; region_id bigint not null — lead region required per Q-9 clarification; broker_id nullable; unique (tenant_id, lead_ref)); lead_assignments (tenant_id, id, lead_id, business_assignment_id, user_id, unique (tenant_id, lead_id, business_assignment_id)); lead_notes; reference_sequences (tenant_id, entity_type, year, next_value, PK (tenant_id, entity_type, year))

Infrastructure/Sequences/ReferenceSequenceService.cs: AllocateAsync(entityType) -> next value via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE within ambient transaction; combined with ReferenceFormatTemplate (T-010) in LeadReferenceGenerator

Features/Leads/CreateLead: CreateLeadCommand carrying Party selection (PartyId XOR InlineParty payload reusing CreatePartyCommand rules), IsExistingClient (required), DateReceived (required, not future), RequestChannelId (required), BrokerId (required iff channel is_broker_channel else optional), OwnerUserId (required; must be eligible for the accountable-owner role via T-011 eligibility), RegionId (required; defaults applied client-side from party), ExternalRef (only when tenant manual_external_ref_enabled; non-blocking uniqueness warning), ProductLineId + CoverTypeId (required; cover type must belong to product line), SumInsured?/EstimatedPremium? (>0 when present), PolicyTerm + PolicyTermOther (required iff Other), Priority (derived High when EstimatedPremium > tenant high_value_threshold, overridable), IntakeNotes -> lead_notes row; handler: generate lead_ref, insert lead with status = canonical 'new' reference item, insert accountable-owner lead_assignment when owner set... note: owner presence at create means status stays New until Assign operation? Per PRD 10.4 New->Assigned happens when accountable owner set via Assign; but intake Owner field is required in browser — decision recorded in spec FR-29/PRD 9.3: browser-created leads store the owner assignment AND remain status New; the T-019 Assign operation transitions status. Implementor must surface this in GetLead availableOperations so Assign is the primary action for New leads with a pre-set owner (it confirms/records date_assigned)

DuplicateLeadChecker: open lead (reporting category open/quoted) same party + product line within tenant duplicate_check_days -> returns warning payload {duplicates:[{leadId, leadRef, status, dateReceived}]}; POST /leads accepts createAnyway:true to bypass; response without createAnyway returns 409-style warning envelope {warnings, requiresConfirmation:true} and does not persist

ListLeadsQuery: filters status[], ownerUserId, brokerId, productLineId, regionId, requestChannelId, dateReceived range, myLeads bool, search (lead_ref/party/broker prefix+trigram); breadth: without PermissionCatalog.Leads.ViewAll restrict to leads having any lead_assignment with current user; sort whitelist, default date_received desc; page size 25; row DTO computes age days, premium display (estimated vs current quoted — quoted branch activates in T-020), flags placeholder

UpdateLeadCommand: intake facts only (FR-30/FR-32); rejects when lead closed (reporting category terminal) unless caller has Leads.CorrectClosed; BulkReassignCommand{leadIds[], newOwnerUserId, note (required per Q-12)} -> per-lead: swap accountable-owner assignment, audit entry per lead; GET /api/v1/parties/{id}/leads + open/total counts and last_activity on party list

findings.description: Stale/contradictory comment in the leads changelog: 090-leads.xml lines 29-32 + header L11-12 state reference_sequences is 'deliberately excluded from create_tenant_partitions.sql' and 'created as a single flat table', but the 093 changeset actually creates it LIST-partitioned with composite (tenant_id,id) PK and it IS registered in create_tenant_partitions.sql:19. Only the earlier prose is out of date; no functional impact.
findings.recommendation: Update the stale comment prose to match the partitioned reality. Non-blocking documentation cleanup.

findings.description: V-030 lists 'outside window -> no warning' as a negative; the closed-status negative (WhenExistingLeadIsClosed_ShouldNotWarnAsDuplicate) is present, but there is no explicit integration test for a duplicate whose date_received is older than duplicate_check_days. The window logic (DateReceived >= sinceDateReceived) is trivial and one negative branch is covered, so minor.
findings.evidence: DuplicateLeadChecker window predicate; no window-boundary test in CreateLeadTests.
findings.recommendation: Add a window-boundary test (a same-party+product-line open lead just OUTSIDE duplicate_check_days -> no warning) when convenient. Non-blocking.

findings.description: IsExistingClient is a non-nullable bool, so an omitted value deserializes to false rather than producing a 422 - 'required' is satisfied structurally, not by validation. Acceptable; the intake form always supplies it.
findings.recommendation: If strict presence-validation is desired later, make it nullable + Required-validated. Acceptable as-is.
